latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of spring-to-solon-skill for guiding Spring Boot / Spring Cloud to Solon migrations.
- Provides expert-driven annotation mapping, dependency replacement, and architecture comparison.
- Includes step-by-step migration checklists for each layer: IoC, Web, Data, Cloud, and Testing.
- All migration rules and reference guides target Solon 3.10.x.
- Supports full Chinese responses and code comments when the user communicates in Chinese.
